# coop-msa_v2-git-gemini-3-8-flash-flash-ref-low-intents

<!-- Generated by tools/export_results.py. Edit only the Experiment and Observations sections. -->

## Experiment

`coop --git` (two agents with messaging and a shared git remote) with the frozen reference settings (`gemini-3.8-flash` on Vertex AI, 500 steps, compaction at 128K tokens, step counter, `$40` per-agent cost cap) at `low` thinking on the 50-pair `flash` subset, adding `message_intents: true` and `intent_presubmit_check: true` (`configs/variants/message_intents_ref_low.yaml`). This is the clean `-c 4` reference rerun of the earlier 100-step / 28K-compaction `-c 10` run ([`coop-msa_v2-git-gemini-3-8-flash-flash-low-intents`](../coop-msa_v2-git-gemini-3-8-flash-flash-low-intents/summary.md)) and compares directly against the [`coop --git` reference run at `low`](../coop-msa_v2-git-gemini-3-8-flash-flash-ref-low/summary.md).

## Observations

- **34/50 (68%) passed with 0 merge conflicts (44 clean, 6 identical branches) and 0 step-limit cutoffs**, matching the [`coop --git` `low` reference baseline](../coop-msa_v2-git-gemini-3-8-flash-flash-ref-low/summary.md) (34/50, 0 conflicts) on the same 50 pairs (`46/50` identical outcomes: `+2` wins on `pallets_click_task/2068` (5,7) and `pallets_click_task/2800` (1,3); `-2` losses on `pallets_click_task/2956` (1,8) and `pallets_jinja_task/1621` (4,10)).
- **Eliminating `-c 10` US business-hour throttling and moving to the 500-step / 128K reference setup jumped pass rate by +6 pairs (+12.0pp, from 28/50 to 34/50) and reduced merge conflicts from 8 to 0** compared to the earlier 100-step / 28K `-c 10` run (`72` retries and `10` false peer-stopped notices vs. **`0` retries** and `0` false peer-stopped notices here).
- **14.8% fewer messages and 5.4% fewer steps than the `low` reference baseline**: explicit intent tags (`Proposal`, `Request`, `Response`, `ACK`, `FYI`) reduced total messages sent from `1,266` (median `25`/pair) to `1,078` (median `21`/pair), total steps from `9,003` (median `79`/agent) to `8,513` (median `76`/agent), cost from `$48.96` to `$47.54`, and wall time from `170` min to `114` min.
- Two agents hit transient LiteLLM empty-choices errors (`list index out of range`): `agent1` on `dspy_task/8394` (3,5) at step 43 (after already pushing its passing branch, though `agent2`'s feature failed its test) and `agent2` on `pallets_click_task/2068` (1,6) at step 60 (after already opening its PR, so the pair still merged cleanly and passed).
